title: The classical open kernel of coefficient-sized localization
statement: Let X be affine in universe u, i:Z→X a closed immersion and j:U→X a quasi-compact open immersion with complementary ranges. Let A be a commutative ring in max v (u+1) and F a coefficient-sized pro-etale sheaf of A-modules. Let eta_F:F→i_*i^*F be the unit of any adjunction between the canonical fixed-module inverse-image/direct-image functors of [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. If j^*F lies in the essential image of the comparison of [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism] over U, then eta_F is epic and ker(eta_F) lies in that essential image over X. No assumption on i^*F is made.

source.place: Tag 09AH, lemma-ses-associated-to-open; Tag 09AF, lemma-jshriek-comparison; Tag 09AK, lemma-compare-constructible, open endpoint

proof.text: Apply the canonical closed-unit epimorphy theorem and the independent kernel comparison theorem. For an arbitrary adjunction with the same left and right functors, Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq gives an isomorphism of left adjoints and its unit formula writes the new unit as the canonical unit followed by an invertible direct-image morphism. Postcomposition by an isomorphism preserves epimorphy. kernel.mapIso identifies the two kernels, and essential-image membership is invariant under this isomorphism.

    Epi (C := Sheaf (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X)
      (ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A)) (adj.unit.app F) ∧
      (Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback
      (Scheme.smallModelComparisonInclusion.{u, v} X) (ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A)
      (Scheme.smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X)
      (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X)).essImage

          (ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A)) (adj.unit.app F))
